key.book_cycle.guardian: Cycle Level-30 Book Enchantments (Auto-Attack XP Mobs)
book_cycle.stance: Stand up and exit spectator mode or free camera before starting.
book_cycle.book: Put exactly one regular book in a hotbar slot.
book_cycle.started: Book cycle started. Press Esc to stop.
book_cycle.guardian_started: Uses the level-30 offer, prioritizes a guardian each cycle, then fills missing XP with silverfish. Press Esc to stop.
book_cycle.sword: Hold a sword in your main hand to attack XP mobs.
book_cycle.cursor_occupied: The cursor is holding an item.
book_cycle.food_sync: Could not confirm the food or held-item swap. Check your inventory.
book_cycle.table_occupied: The enchanting table's book slot contains a different item.
book_cycle.timeout: No expected response from the enchanting table or grindstone.
book_cycle.enchant_timeout: No enchantment result. Check the book and lapis in the enchanting table.
book_cycle.reach: Stand where both blocks are visible and within reach.
book_cycle.lapis_sync_timeout: Could not confirm the lapis transfer into the enchanting table.
book_cycle.empty_supply: No lapis supplies in your inventory or nearby barrels.
book_cycle.inventory_full: Free an inventory slot for lapis supplies.
book_cycle.book_space: Free an inventory slot so the book can be taken out.
book_cycle.craft_result: Could not confirm the lapis decompression result.
book_cycle.loot_crafting_table: Shards and crystals will be held until a crafting table is within reach.
book_cycle.loot_craft_skipped: Loot crafting was unavailable. Keeping the materials and resupplying lapis.
book_cycle.xp: At least one experience level is required.
book_cycle.xp_offer: The level-30 offer requires experience level %s.
book_cycle.bookshelves: The third offer is not level 30 (currently %s). Check the 15-bookshelf setup.
book_cycle.result: The grindstone result is not a regular book.
